title: natrually generating hello
description: this datapack adds a natrually generating hello structure
body:
# what this adds? 
adds a structure named hello world which is the word "HELLO" in uppercase made out of cobblestone

# where do i find it?
this struture is found the plains biome or if you want to use the locate command
type the command /locate structure natruallygeneratinghello:hello 
or if you want to use the place command to place it
/place structure natruallygeneratinghello:hello
